description: Deliberate: schedule restricts when pull requests are OPENED, not when they merge.
Renovate reports 'Automerge: At any time (no schedule defined)' regardless of it.
Renovate can also be told to run directly from the Mend dashboard, so activity
outside this window is expected and is not a sign of a broken schedule.
Do not remove this as setup debris. See doc/decisions/build-and-dependencies.md.

customManagers.description: The Jib base image, pinned by tag and digest. Loose versioning compares jre-runtime's <temurin>-<yyyymmdd> tags number by number, so a newer Temurin build or a newer date wins. It lives in a Quarkus properties file, which no built-in manager reads: the Maven manager updates dependency versions, not a container reference, so moving it into pom.xml would not have helped either.

The pinned OpenTofu version in the CI workflow. The github-actions manager updates the action reference, not an input passed to it, so without this the pin would never move -- the same gap as the Jib base image above. The pin itself is deliberate: tofu fmt output has changed between minor releases, so CI and the developer machine must agree.

packageRules.description: Bug-fix and minor updates merge themselves once every check is green.
Major updates open a pull request and wait for a human to merge it.
One pull request for the Quarkus platform rather than one per artifact, because the BOM and the extensions have to move together.
React and its type definitions are a set; splitting them produces pull requests that cannot pass tsc on their own.
Test tooling churns often and cannot break production, so it travels together.
